description: Fixed backup containers, written by the hosts' encoder: one disk of a 4 MiB chunk of repeated text, a 4 MiB zero chunk and 1000 bytes of noise, encoded as version 2 (backup-v2.ghb) and version 1 (backup-v1.ghb) with nonce prefix 0x42 repeated, under the data key of the rewrap vector of client-api's backup-key-vectors.json, wrapped to the recovery key of its account seed (sevens).
